note: v485: Fixes the zoom bug. Tapping a box on the invoice screen (and a few other tight rows — the date filters, the statements month picker) zoomed the whole page in and left it there, with the layout cut off. iPhone does that to any text box whose text is smaller than 16px, and it never zooms back out on its own. Every text box you can tap on a phone or tablet is now at least 16px, so it stays put. Pinch-to-zoom still works when you actually want it.
